  • You want to see what's coming out. You go to social media, not gamingsite.com
  • You want to find out about a specific game. You go to google, not gamingsite.com
  • You want to see trailers/gameplay. You go to youtube, not gamingsite.com
  • You want to see review scores. You go to metacritic, not gamingsite.com

  • Partner with game companies to offer special sales/deals to your audience (think a "humble bundle" but focused on your niche and specific to your site)
  • Sell a service, like teaching people to play X game at a competitive level, or helping build the ultimate gaming PC, or a member only tips and tricks forum etc.
